groups.text: A year ago, the famous astronaut received an invitation by airmail from a remote village. Intending to sniff some fresh air, he and his interpreter paid a fortnight’s visit there. It was a privilege for them to be there, but they were shocked by what they saw.
groups.zh: 一年前，这位著名宇航员收到一封来自偏远村庄的航空邀请信。为了呼吸一些新鲜空气，他和翻译在那里访问了两周。能到那里，他们觉得十分荣幸，却也被眼前的情景震惊了。

groups.text: The tracks were muddy. The river was drying up. Most villagers only possessed one broom, a few tins and several jars and their rectangular grass huts with rounded corners were surrounded by weeds.
groups.zh: 小路泥泞不堪。河水正在干涸。大多数村民只有一把扫帚，几个铁罐和几个坛子，他们带着圆角的长方形茅草屋，四周长满了杂草。

groups.text: Besides, their school had no roof and platform, and the students had no concept of clicking a computer at all. They were badly in need. Soon, the astronaut made a generous voluntary donation to the village.
groups.zh: 此外，学校没有屋顶，也没有讲台，学生完全不知道如何点击操作电脑。他们急需帮助。不久，宇航员自愿向村庄作了一笔慷慨捐赠。

groups.text: There were textbooks for students, sewing machines for tailors and tractors for farmers. His distribution catalogue also included operating a clinic and a trunk library, as well as giving weekly lessons to teach relevant farming knowledge like how to dry out seeds or raise oxen. He himself not only helped do some paperwork but also purchased grills for boys to toast potatoes and combs for girls who were dying to get one.
groups.zh: 有送给学生的课本，送给裁缝的缝纫机，以及送给农民的拖拉机。他的援助清单还包括开办诊所和箱式流动图书馆，以及每周开设课程，传授相关农业知识，例如如何晒干种子、饲养耕牛。他自己不但帮忙做文书工作，还为男孩们买了烤架，让他们烤土豆，并给非常想要梳子的女孩们买了梳子。

groups.text: The other day, he heard from the villagers again inviting him to participate in the donation anniversary. For political and security reasons, he couldn’t adjust his travel arrangements-otherwise he would go. But his deeds were remembered forever.
groups.zh: 前几天，他再次收到了村民的来信，邀请他参加捐赠周年纪念活动。由于政治和安全方面的原因，他无法调整出行安排，否则他就会去了。但他的善举永远被人铭记。
